checks.detail: import skimage.data -> ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'skimage'. Upstream's camera()/moon() sample is unavailable, so a deterministic siemens_star amplitude and radial-cosine phase are substituted and upstream's published losses are recorded for reference rather than asserted.
checks.name: scikit_image_is_not_available_in_the_pinned_environment

checks.detail: 4.20% of the sample amplitude's spectral energy is above the NA/lambda = 0.5639 cycles/um coherent cutoff (Nyquist is 1.6667). Without that, Fourier ptychography would have nothing to recover and every check below would be vacuous.
checks.name: the_sample_carries_energy_the_pupil_cannot_pass

checks.detail: 121 illuminations from an 11x11 kykx grid, matching upstream's '121 measured images'
checks.name: an_eleven_by_eleven_grid_gives_121_illuminations

checks.detail: only 0.724% of the on-axis image's spectral energy sits above the 0.5639 cycles/um cutoff, against 4.20% in the sample. ff_lens(..., NA=0.3) really is limiting the transferred band.
checks.name: the_brightfield_image_is_band_limited_by_the_pupil

checks.detail: RMS difference from the on-axis image: 1.426833e-06 for the adjacent tilt and 2.591150e-05 for the extreme corner tilt, against an image RMS of 2.612210e-05. The 121 measurements are not 121 copies, and the difference grows with tilt as the shifted pupil samples a different part of the sample spectrum.
checks.name: tilting_the_illumination_changes_which_frequencies_get_through

checks.detail: mean loss per sweep of all 121 images: 2.272e-10 -> 8.267e-12 -> 6.784e-12 -> 5.485e-12 -> 4.279e-12 -> 3.214e-12 -> 2.327e-12 -> 1.634e-12 -> 1.120e-12 -> 7.553e-13, a 301x reduction over 10 sweeps. Upstream reports 1.84e-10 -> 6.69e-12 -> 8.81e-13 ... on its own sample; the trajectory shape matches even though the absolute values cannot.
checks.name: the_sweep_mean_loss_falls_monotonically_by_orders_of_magnitude

checks.detail: Pearson r with the true amplitude: 0.945776 for the initial brightfield guess -> 0.992469 for the reconstruction
checks.name: the_reconstruction_matches_the_true_amplitude_better_than_the_initial_guess

checks.detail: spectral energy above the 0.5639 cycles/um single-image cutoff: 0.7236% in the brightfield measurement versus 3.3573% in the reconstruction, a factor of 4.6. Synthesising a wider aperture than any single measurement provides is the entire point of Fourier ptychography, and it is checkable with no reference value at all.
checks.name: the_reconstruction_recovers_frequencies_no_single_image_carries

demonstrates: cx.plane_wave(kykx=) tilted illumination, amplitude_change + phase_change for a complex sample, a two-lens 4f system via ff_lens(..., NA=), jax.vmap over 121 illuminations, and SGD reconstruction of amplitude and phase through the forward model.
title: Fourier Ptychography
